Name: Laura Jones
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Interpreting Visual Texts feels most immediately usable in my context. I already often have students do visual quick writes, and this feels like a way to add to their understanding. I can give them more meaningful questions to go with it and maybe expand into more complex visuals, like graphs.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I teach writing, so every day we write a bit. The biggest challenges is time, or having students that are not as engaged with the assignment, so they struggle to give the level of writing they should be at.
